_comment: Model registry. Switch with --model / --fallback or INVOICE_MODEL / INVOICE_FALLBACK. Simulated models run offline; real models need an API key and the matching langchain package.

sim-strong.description: Large, careful model: rare field errors, slower, pricier

sim-fast.description: Small, fast model: cheap, more extraction slips

sim-weak.description: Weak model: frequent bad JSON and invented fields

sim-flaky.description: Good model behind an unreliable provider: timeouts, 429s and 5xx

claude-sonnet.description: Real Claude model via langchain-anthropic (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)

claude-haiku.description: Real Claude model via langchain-anthropic (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)

openai-mini.description: Real OpenAI model via langchain-openai (needs OPENAI_API_KEY)
